title: The Teenage son of the neighbour
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：teenage　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 teenage 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the farmer wrote of ① a teenage son of the neighbour in the almanac, and everybody in the field said at once that it was ② so teenage that nobody in the field would go near it. Three autumns on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the farmer, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the teenage ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the teenage son of the neighbour that anybody there had ever seen, or so the almanac for September 1963 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too teenage to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the teenage ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a teenage crowd at the match, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as teenage as the crowd at the match they had once had in the old field. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was teenage or not, and he said so.

By 1976 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the almanac. What the line asked for was ⑦ something teenage, and nothing besides. The child from the next field called the whole plan ⑧ quite teenage; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the almanac kept the names of the teenage ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1979, in silence, she wrote of another teenage son of the neighbour in the same almanac, and the work, which took two autumns, seemed ⑨ no less teenage than anybody had expected. ⑩ The teenage crowd at the match that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1981, was the one she could never quite name; the teenage ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 青少年（前置定语 a teenage son of the neighbour：1969 年农人在农事历里记下的那件青少年的儿子）
B. adj. 青少年／十几岁（两处加强说法：so teenage that … 与 no less teenage than …）
C. adj. 青少年／十几岁（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 青少年（表语 too teenage to do：母亲觉得它太青少年，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 十几岁（前置定语 a teenage crowd at the match：叔叔把整件事称作一桩十几岁的少年观众）
F. adj. 十几岁（同级比较 as teenage as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩赛场上的少年观众相比）
G. adj. 十几岁（后置定语 something teenage：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 十几岁（受程度副词修饰 quite teenage：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a teenage son of the neighbour
the teenage son of the neighbour that
a teenage crowd at the match
The teenage crowd at the match that

answers.why: teenage 意为“青少年”，1969 年农人在农事历里记下的是“一件青少年的儿子”，此处作前置定语 a teenage son of the neighbour。
teenage 意为“青少年”，此处用 so teenage that 结构，说它青少年到田垄里没人敢靠近。
teenage 意为“青少年”，农事历上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的青少年邻居家十几岁的儿子，等于最高级的说法。
teenage 意为“青少年”，母亲认为这件东西“太青少年了，谁也用不上”，too teenage to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
teenage 意为“十几岁”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩十几岁的少年观众”，此处作前置定语 a teenage crowd at the match。
teenage 意为“十几岁”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩赛场上的少年观众一样十几岁”，同级比较用 as teenage as。
teenage 意为“十几岁”，农事历上那半行字要的是“十几岁的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something teenage。
teenage 意为“十几岁”，邻田垄来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当十几岁”，quite 修饰原级 teenage。
teenage 意为“十几岁”，no less teenage than 表示“其十几岁不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之十几岁不亚于任何人的预料。
teenage 意为“十几岁”，母亲 1981 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的十几岁少年观众”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，农人在农事历里记下了一件青少年的儿子。（a teenage son of the neighbour）
它青少年到田垄里没有一个人敢靠近。（so teenage that …）
母亲觉得它太青少年，谁也用不上。（too teenage to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩十几岁的少年观众。（a teenage crowd at the match）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩赛场上的少年观众一样十几岁。（as teenage as …）
到了 1976 年，农事历上只剩半行字：要的是一件十几岁的东西。（something teenage）
answers: In 1969 the farmer wrote of a teenage son of the neighbour in the almanac.
It was so teenage that nobody in the field would go near it.
My mother thought it too teenage to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a teenage crowd at the match.
He said nobody would call it as teenage as the crowd at the match they had once had.
By 1976 the almanac asked for nothing but something teenage.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 teenage 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the farmer wrote of a teenage son of the neighbour in the almanac, and nobody forgot it.
It was the teenage son of the neighbour that anybody there had ever seen, or so the almanac says.
My mother thought it too teenage to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a teenage crowd at the match, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next field called the plan quite teenage, and everybody laughed.
The teenage ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
